mechanism: Everolimus (mTOR inhibitor) may increase atomoxetine levels through CYP3A4 inhibition and additive CNS effects; atomoxetine has sympathomimetic activity that may compound everolimus-associated cardiovascular risks.
action: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and signs of atomoxetine toxicity; consider dose adjustment of atomoxetine or alternative ADHD therapy; baseline and periodic cardiac assessment recommended.
